title: Transformer-based In-Context Score Operator Learning for Diffusion Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.13690v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Diffusion models typically learn the generative dynamics of a single target distribution or a family of distributions indexed by conditioning variables fixed during training. This limits their ability to adapt to a previously unseen distribution from only a small set of examples. We introduce an in-context solution operator learning framework for diffusion models, in which each target distribution is treated as a task drawn from a meta-distribution and is specified at inference time by an empirical context set. Our method learns an in-context score operator that maps the context samples, a noisy query point, and the diffusion time to the task-dependent score, enabling reverse-diffusion sampling on unseen tasks without retraining or parameter updates. A key observation is that the task-dependent score admits a Gaussian-kernel conditional-mean representation. Its empirical Nadaraya--Watson approximation can be represented exactly by a mode

translated_title: 基于Transformer的扩散模型上下文内分数算子学习
translated_abstract: 扩散模型通常学习单一目标分布或由训练时固定的条件变量所索引的一族分布的生成动力学，这限制了它们仅凭少量样本适应前所未见分布的能力。我们为扩散模型引入了一种上下文内解算子学习框架，其中每个目标分布被视为从元分布中抽取的一个任务，并在推理时由经验上下文样本集来指定。我们的方法学习一个上下文内分数算子，该算子将上下文样本、带噪声的查询点以及扩散时间映射到依赖任务的分数，从而无需再训练或参数更新即可在未见任务上进行反向扩散采样。一个关键观察是，依赖任务的分数具有高斯核条件均值表示形式，其经验Nadaraya-Watson近似可以由一个Transformer精确表示。
tldr: 本文提出一种基于Transformer的上下文内分数算子学习框架，使扩散模型仅需少量示例样本即可在推理时适应从未见过的分布，无需再训练或参数更新就能完成反向扩散采样。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a Transformer-based in-context score operator learning framework that enables diffusion models to adapt to unseen distributions at inference time from only a small set of examples, performing reverse-diffusion sampling without retraining or parameter updates.
